preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100000 for s in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each string S has a length between 1 and 100000 inclusive.
The sum of the lengths of all strings S does not exceed 100000.
Each string S consists only of lowercase letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum((len(substring) ** len(set(substring))) % 1000000007 for s in stdin.split()[1:] for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i + 1, len(s) + 1) for substring in {s[i:j]}) % 1000000007
postconditions.description: The output is the summation of F(substring) for all distinct substrings of each string S, modulo 1000000007.
